write|claude-opus-5-5|t32.conclusion: On this farm, plots given slow-release fertilizer yielded on average about 3.3 kg more tomatoes than plots under usual practice (26.2 vs 23.0 kg per plot; 95% interval 2.7 to 3.9 kg).
